resources.string: Both players play at the same time. Each centre pile shows a card.
Play a card from your hand onto a centre pile if it is exactly one rank higher or lower. Aces sit between kings and twos.
Your hand refills from your draw pile. Play every card of your hand and draw pile to win.
Nobody can play? Tap Flip and new cards turn up in the centre. Prefer to take turns? Turn on Turn-based assist.
Speed is also called Spit or Slam, and most versions use a single 52-card deck.
The cards lie face down. On your turn, tap two cards to turn them over.
Same picture? You keep the pair and go again. Different? They turn back and the turn passes.
Remember where each picture is. Hint shows a pair you have already seen.
The board ends when every pair is found. With friends the most pairs wins; alone, aim for fewer moves and a faster time.
This game is also called Concentration, Memory, Pairs or Pelmanism, after a British memory-training system.
